scope: Locked two-stage official test prediction then scoring, paired bootstrap and descriptive sex/mother-language groups
fit: All five models refit on all development210 only; demographics OLS unpenalized; audio training-only StandardScaler and double residualization then Ridge only on residual audio.

stages.prepare_inputs: Write physically label-free predictors.csv; development_targets.csv contains only210 development labels; projections never access test target values. Keep source evidence hashes.
stages.predict: Load only predictors.csv, development_targets.csv and validated feature NPZ; no original speakers CSV target fields. Produce both-target test predictions, ID/finite/range audit, save exact predictions SHA and source/config/view lock before scoring.
stages.score: Only after immutable saved prediction hash/source/config hashes and label-free audit all pass, join test BMI/height by exact speaker IDs; do not fit or choose settings. Refuse overwrite.
stages.source_hash_chain: Before predicting save immutable config+predictor/dev-target/validated NPZ+all computing source/ref hashes; after predictions save CSV hash and ID/schema/finite audit. Before score opens source target CSV, verify all prior hashes and audit; then freeze score lock with target source SHA and all score/bootstrap/group dependencies.

prediction_quality.range_audit: Only describe min/max relative to development target min/max; no clipping, parameter change or exclusion based on test values or predictions.

bootstrap.individual_support_rule: primary delta MAE upper 95% percentile endpoint < 0
bootstrap.family_adjusted_support_rule: primary delta MAE upper97.5% percentile endpoint <0; two target comparisons form one family
bootstrap.uncertainty_scope: Conditional on fitted models and this test population; does not include training variability or full selection-process uncertainty.

secondary_interpretation: 95% paired intervals descriptive; no additional family-level confirmatory claim

group_analysis.small_group_note: Report all counts; small groups unstable, no subgroup significance claims or group-wise tuning.

expectations_before_test: Development gain can shrink due to alpha/layer selection and distribution change; no numerical forecast of test gain. Report both targets and all locked models regardless of direction.
scientific_wording: Speech features associated with BMI/height; no causal or layer-specific physiological interpretation. Language, channel/session and recording conditions remain possible confounds.
pre_fit_amendment: Clarify two-sided percentile quantiles, raw group categories, exact prediction schema/order and hash-chain gates before test values are parsed. Model/layer/alpha settings unchanged.
